author: Lermjt
quote: Honestly, GTA 6 is one of the biggest disappointments ever. The hype is completely undeserved. Everything feels overrated, and Rockstar has spent years making people believe this game will be revolutionary. The graphics might look good, but that doesn’t automatically make it a masterpiece. Expectations are ridiculously high, and I seriously doubt the game will live up to them. Nothing but overhyped marketing. What a joke.
